rationale: Backport the reviewed retained NativeCanvasPainter primitive from immutable Vellum commit ab5cca9c7a6219ee3e2820ce6fa5c757b479f1c1. The primitive gives imported native CanvasWidget programs a bounded painter callback with explicit backend identity and state cleanup; Pulp consumes it for the Chromium-to-DesignIR-to-Skia migration without forking canvas semantics in import tooling.
